newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 100 bln yen Euroyen bond entirely placed.
newsitem.headline: Italy 100 bln yen Euroyen bond entirely placed.

text.p: The Italian Republic's first operation of 1997 - a 100 billion yen euroyen bond led by Nikko Europe and issued on Tuesday - has been entirely placed, sources close to the lead manager said.
The bond, due March 24, 2017, carries a coupon of 3.45 percent, the lowest ever obtained by Italy in this market. The spread over equivalent JGBs is 16.4 basis points.
The last Italian Republic euroyen bond was launched last October for an amount of 100 billion yen. Due in 2016 with a 3.7 percent coupon, the spread on that issue was equal to 22 bps.
The Italian Treasury in February announced a 1997 programme of bond issues on markets abroad for a total of $11 to 14 billion.
